lesson.title: Preparation
lesson.subtitle: The setup and preparation stage
lesson.summary: We install what you need, open the accounts, and set up the environment we will use throughout the praktikum.

prep.intro: The first lesson is {sana}. Have this list ready by then — it takes about 30 minutes in all, and it means we start working straight away in class.

items.title: A computer
items.note: A MacBook is recommended, Windows works too. A phone or a tablet is not enough.
steps: Bring your own laptop — the praktikum is hands-on from beginning to end.
Leave at least 5 GB free on the disk.

items.title: A Google account
items.note: Claude, NotebookLM and Gemini all open through this account. If you already have one, you do not need a new one.
steps: Enter your first name, last name and a new email address.
Confirm your phone number — a code arrives by SMS.
Write the password down: you will need it in class.

items.title: Claude
items.note: The main tool of the praktikum. Open an account on claude.ai first, then install the app.
steps: Go to claude.ai and sign up with "Continue with Google".
Mac: open the .dmg and drag the Claude icon into Applications.
Windows: run the .exe and confirm the installation.
Sign in to the app with that same Google account.

items.title: A Visa card
items.note: You will need it for a Claude Pro subscription. The free tier is enough for the first lesson.
steps: Get an international Visa or Mastercard from your bank — Uzcard and Humo do not work here.
The card needs a dollar account with online payments enabled.
Pro costs $20 a month. It is not required, but it makes the work considerably easier.
items.footnote: You will need it in the later lessons.
